items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and authorize only preparation of an unsent written permission request to Woot. Evidence: current Woot terms do not establish rights for public commercial display, derivatives, caching, or alerts; legal, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain blocked. Unknown: whether Woot will grant the required rights. Smallest next step: owner selects one option—(A) prepare the permission request for review, (B) no outreach and keep private, or (C) end the public-beta pursuit. Separately, prioritize four reversible SEO changes below: the scorecard has 75 SEO actions, 48 high priority, 0 proven improvements, and 3 changes still measuring.

CRO leads for markitdown, shadcn/ui, the Great Lakes affiliate module, and the Deep Penetrations experiment are deferred this cycle: existing approved-proposal execution is only 9%, 129 approved proposals lack execution requests, and the relevant sites already have active or measuring work. The evidence is preserved; no additional research or adoption is justified until the execution backlog drains.
